'''Fur cap brown''' is an armor piece which can be purchased from [[Hildir]] for {{Item Link|Coins|200}}. This item will be in the merchant's assortment only after returning [[Hildir's brass chest]].

==Notes==
* Wearing this armor decreases stamina usage while using the [[Hammer]], the [[Hoe]], the [[Cultivator]], and the [[Serving Tray]] by 15%.
